name: kasbifydev
description: Kasbify developer operations for inspecting and managing Odoo through a remote MCP backend.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and operate Odoo from ChatGPT and Codex
interface.longDescription: KasbifyDev packages safe Odoo engineering workflows around a remote MCP server. It guides schema discovery, read operations, controlled writes, troubleshooting, and project or CRM maintenance without guessing Odoo fields or bypassing confirmation gates.

Diagnose this Odoo problem using schema and method discovery before proposing a fix
